items.computation: Letter dated 31.12.2025, posted to mail on 02.01.2026 per the letter's own notice ('wurde am 02.01.2026 zur Post gegeben'). Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a letter sent by post is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: 02.01.2026 + 4 days = 06.01.2026. However the tool anchors from the printed document date (31.12.2025) as posting day, giving 4th day = 04.01.2026 (Sunday), shifted to Monday 05.01.2026 as deemed delivery under § 108 Abs. 3 AO. Since the letter explicitly confirms actual posting on 02.01.2026, the more accurate deemed-delivery date computed from that posting day would be 06.01.2026 (Tuesday, no shift needed), one day later than the tool's date based on the printed document date. To be safe, the later of the two readings is used: one month from deemed delivery, counted per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB. Using 05.01.2026 as start (day not counted), one month later lands on 05.02.2026, a Thursday (business day, no shift needed). Using 06.01.2026 as start, one month later would be 06.02.2026. The earlier, safer (i.e. earliest plausible for compliance, but here we take the later actually correct date to avoid missing the deadline) date to rely on for filing is 06.02.2026; however since the letter's printed 'Datum des Bescheids' is 31.12.2025 and the explicit posting note refers to 02.01.2026, the correct anchor is the actual posting date stated in the letter (02.01.2026), giving deemed delivery on 06.01.2026 and Einspruch deadline of 06.02.2026 (Friday).
